full_prompt_en: A square editorial fashion photograph shows a woman seated squarely at a dining table in a nearly all-yellow room. She faces the camera with a straight back and a composed, unsmiling expression. Dark hair is slicked tightly back into a neat center-parted shape. Oversized round sunglasses with thick lemon-yellow rims and dark black lenses conceal her eyes. Small gold earrings, a short necklace, and vivid red lipstick punctuate the otherwise controlled palette. She wears a fitted, high-neck yellow outfit with a narrow row of buttons down the center and ruffled cuffs at the wrists. Long matching gloves cover both forearms; her hands are stacked horizontally beneath her chin, elbows resting on the table, making a crisp mirrored pose. The background is a flat acid-yellow wall interrupted near the lower third by simple horizontal molding. A pale mint woven chair back curves behind her shoulders. In the foreground, a shallow plate of leafy green food sits centered before her on layered white dishes with dark rims. A white bowl containing more greens occupies the left edge. At right, several yellow lemons cluster behind another white dish. Pale table linen and small cutlery provide orderly horizontal and vertical accents below the figure. The frontal composition is almost perfectly symmetrical around her face, hands, and central plate, while the side bowls and citrus balance each other. Bright even studio light makes the yellow fabric and wall glow without deep shadow; compact shading under the chin, around the gloves, and beneath the plates still gives the objects volume. The photographic surfaces are sleek and sharply resolved, with fine textile and woven-chair texture visible inside broad, flat color fields. Yellow dominates almost every plane, with small mint, green, black, white, and crimson interruptions. The result is theatrical, precise, and slightly uncanny, like a carefully staged still life built around a motionless model.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形时尚编辑摄影呈现一名女子端坐在几乎全黄色的餐室桌前。她正面面对相机，背部挺直，神情克制而不露笑意。深色头发从中间分开，紧紧梳向后方。厚柠檬黄镜框的大圆墨镜遮住双眼，镜片接近黑色。小金色耳饰、短项链与鲜明的正红色唇妆，在受控配色中形成点睛之处。她穿合身的高领黄色服装，正中排着一列细扣，手腕处有荷叶边。两条长长的同色手套包住前臂；双手水平叠放在下巴下，双肘支在桌面上，形成清楚的镜像姿态。背景是一片酸黄色墙面，只在下三分之一处被简洁水平护墙线切开。浅薄荷绿的编织椅背在她双肩后弯成一圈。前景，一浅盘绿叶食物居中放在带深色边线的叠层白盘上。左缘的白碗中还有更多绿叶菜。右侧几颗黄柠檬聚在另一只白盘后。浅色桌布与小件餐具在人物下方形成规整的横竖点缀。正面构图几乎完全围绕脸、双手和中央餐盘对称，两侧菜碗和柑橘彼此平衡。明亮均匀的摄影棚光让黄色衣料与墙面发亮，却不产生深重投影；下巴、手套和盘子下方的紧凑阴影仍给予物件体积。摄影表面光洁、解析清晰，大块平整色域中仍看得到细致布料和藤编肌理。黄色主宰几乎每个平面，只被少量薄荷绿、叶绿、黑、白和绯红打断。整体如同围绕一位静止模特精心布置的静物画，戏剧化、精确，也有一丝奇异。
style_prompt_en: Use highly staged editorial color photography with frontal symmetry, an assertive single-hue environment, and exact placement of small contrasting objects. Saturate the dominant color across wall, costume, accessories, and props so they join into broad graphic fields, then use a few complementary cool notes and a tiny sharp warm accent to create visual rhythm. Keep silhouettes crisp, surfaces polished, and materials legible through fine textile, woven, glass, and ceramic texture. Employ bright, even studio illumination that maintains dense color while leaving only short, deliberate shadows beneath forms. Arrange hands or objects into stable geometric gestures, and balance foreground props around a central axis. A compressed, orderly room and minimal background molding support the graphic composition. Let vivid color, formal poise, and meticulous still-life spacing create a poised but slightly uncanny theatrical mood.
style_prompt_zh: 采用高度摆拍的编辑摄影方式，以正面轴线对称、强势的单色环境和精确安置的小件对比物组织画面。让主色贯穿墙面、服装、配饰及道具，连成宽阔的图形色域，再用少数互补冷色与一处尖锐暖色建立节奏。保持轮廓利落、表面光洁，同时通过细致的织物、编织、玻璃与陶瓷肌理让材质可辨。使用明亮均匀的影棚照明，维持浓密色彩，只在物件下方留下短促而有意安排的阴影。将手势或物品摆成稳定的几何形，并围绕中轴平衡前景道具。紧凑整齐的室内与最少量的背景线脚支撑图形化构图。以鲜艳色彩、正式姿态和精密的静物间距，形成从容却略带奇异的戏剧感。
theme_en: A woman in vivid yellow seated at a table with green food and lemons
theme_zh: 一位身穿鲜黄色服装的女子坐在摆有绿菜与柠檬的餐桌前
name: Miles Aldridge
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
